mcqs.question: Consider segment AB and segment CD. Which of the following statements correctly identifies the endpoints of each segment?

options.A: A and B are the endpoints of segment AB; C and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.B: A and C are the endpoints of segment AB; B and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.C: A and D are the endpoints of segment AB; B and C are the endpoints of segment CD.
options.D: B and C are the endpoints of segment AB; A and D are the endpoints of segment CD.

mcqs.answer: A and B are the endpoints of segment AB; C and D are the endpoints of segment CD.
mcqs.explanation: In a line segment, the two points that mark its extremes are called endpoints. For segment AB the endpoints are A and B; for segment CD they are C and D. The other options mix up the points, so they do not correctly identify the endpoints.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the part joining two points
mcqs.question: Points P and Q are joined by a straight line in a diagram. Which statement best describes the geometric object that represents the part joining P and Q?

options.A: It is a ray that starts at P and passes through Q, extending indefinitely beyond Q.
options.B: It is a line segment, the shortest straight path that connects P and Q.
options.C: It is a line, extending infinitely in both directions beyond P and Q.
options.D: It is a curved arc passing through P and Q.

mcqs.answer: It is a line segment, the shortest straight path that connects P and Q.
mcqs.explanation: The part that directly joins two distinct points is a line segment. A ray continues beyond one endpoint, a line continues beyond both endpoints, and a curve is not straight. Hence option B correctly describes the joining part.

mcqs.learning_point: Measure the length of a segment
mcqs.question: On a grid where each small square side is 1 cm, segment XY passes through 5 squares horizontally and 3 squares vertically. What is the length of XY (in cm)?
mcqs.explanation: The horizontal change is 5 cm and the vertical change is 3 cm. By the Pythagorean theorem, length = √(5² + 3²) = √34 ≈ 5.83 cm. Options A, B, and D ignore the diagonal nature of the segment.

mcqs.question: Segment MN is 7 cm long and segment PQ is 5 cm long. Which statement is true?

options.A: Segment MN is shorter than segment PQ.
options.B: Both segments have the same length.
options.C: Segment MN is longer than segment PQ.
options.D: It is impossible to compare their lengths without a ruler.

mcqs.answer: Segment MN is longer than segment PQ.
mcqs.explanation: Since 7 cm > 5 cm, segment MN is longer than segment PQ. Option A reverses the relationship, B is false, and D is unnecessary because the lengths are given.

mcqs.question: Which definition correctly distinguishes an endpoint of a line segment from an interior point?

options.A: An endpoint lies on the segment, while an interior point lies outside the segment.
options.B: An endpoint is one of the two extreme points of the segment; an interior point lies between the two endpoints.
options.C: An endpoint is the midpoint of the segment; an interior point is any other point on the segment.
options.D: Endpoints and interior points are the same; both are any points on the segment.

mcqs.answer: An endpoint is one of the two extreme points of the segment; an interior point lies between the two endpoints.
mcqs.explanation: A line segment has exactly two endpoints, the extreme points where the segment starts and ends. Any point that is not an endpoint but still lies on the segment is an interior point. Options A, C, and D give incorrect descriptions.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the part joining two points
mcqs.question: A gardener wants to connect two trees with a straight fence. Which geometric object best represents the fence?
mcqs.explanation: The fence has a definite start at one tree and a definite end at the other tree, matching the definition of a line segment. A ray would continue beyond one tree, a line would extend infinitely in both directions, and a curve would not be straight.

mcqs.learning_point: Measure the length of a segment
mcqs.question: If segment AB measures 8 cm, what is the length of a segment that is exactly twice as long as AB?
mcqs.explanation: Twice the length of 8 cm is 2 × 8 = 16 cm. Options A and B are smaller than the original, and C is only 1.5 times the original.

mcqs.question: On a school playground, segment AB is 120 m long and segment CD is 150 m long. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Segment AB is longer than segment CD.
options.B: Both segments are of equal length.
options.C: Segment CD is longer than segment AB.
options.D: The lengths cannot be compared without measuring tools.

mcqs.answer: Segment CD is longer than segment AB.
mcqs.explanation: Since 150 m > 120 m, segment CD is longer. Option A reverses the relationship, B is false, and D is unnecessary because the lengths are already given.
